neighbours.label: transformation verb in home-decorating copy ('create beautiful spaces', 'transform a room', 'make your kitchen look different')
fire: Our designers offer simple, affordable ways to create beautiful living spaces in any home.
A bold accent wall can transform a plain bedroom into a cozy retreat.
New cabinet hardware will make your bathroom look completely refreshed.
Layered throw pillows add a fresh touch to any living room sofa.
Natural wood flooring can turn a dull hallway into an elegant entrance.
With the right lighting you can give your dining room a warm, inviting feel.
Patterned wallpaper is an easy way to refresh a tired guest room.
Mirrors and soft rugs help brighten a small apartment and make it feel larger.
quiet: Our plumbers offer fast, affordable repairs for leaking pipes in any home.
A broken water heater can leave a family without hot water for days.
New cabinet hinges must be screwed in tightly so the doors do not sag.
The living room sofa was delivered on Tuesday and assembled by the movers.
Wood flooring should be cleaned with a damp mop rather than soaking wet.
The dining room has two windows that face the garden and a door to the porch.
The guest room is on the second floor next to the main bathroom.
The small apartment has one bedroom, a kitchen and a shared laundry room.

notes: top examples are create/transform/make/add a touch in interior-design marketing text
